definitions.explanation: A loanword from English "dumbbell," the short hand-held weight used for strength training. Sold in fixed or adjustable weights.

examples.japanese: ダンベル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{上|あ}げる→持ち上げる：02313_mochiageru⟧。
⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧ダンベル⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{筋|きん}トレ→筋トレ：04915_kintore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I do strength training with dumbbells every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧ダンベル⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{重|おも}く→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧いく。
examples.english: Start with light dumbbells and gradually make them heavier.

notes:
A loanword from English "dumbbell," the short hand-held weight used for strength training. Sold in fixed or adjustable weights.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ダンベル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{上|あ}げる→持ち上げる：02313_mochiageru⟧: to lift a dumbbell
- ダンベル⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧: dumbbell exercises
- ⟦{可変|かへん}→可変：21087_kahen⟧ダンベル: adjustable dumbbell

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦バーベル→バーベル：29747_baaberu⟧: barbell — the long, two-handed version
- ⟦{鉄|てつ}アレイ→鉄アレイ：29749_tetsuarei⟧: dumbbell — traditional native term for the same thing
